text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My dearest Trainer. Today is Valentine's 
Day, you see~, so I have a little present 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to give you something, so would 
you mind coming with me for a moment~?

Normally, it'd be behind the school 
building. Or eating chocolate parfaits 
together at some cafe, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's quite close. About a 7-hour flight by 
plane~.
(Screeech!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Come, please take a look~ At this 
lovely... "Cacao Tree".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I planted it just for you, Trainer. The 
whole tree is yours~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"All the fruit harvested from this tree 
belongs to you, Trainer-sama, you know?"

As expected of the Mejiro family—operating 
on a whole different level... I never 
imagined they'd gift me an entire cacao 
tree.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It takes some time for the fruit to grow, 
so please wait a little while~
choice_data_list:
When you say 'a little,' how much do you 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see~. From what I have heard... It 
has been about four years or so~."
choice_data_list: I-isn't that a little too laid-back?

text_block_list.text:
It seemed it would take an absurd amount 
of time before we could actually eat it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I do apologize~ Still, having taken our 
time with it, the joy when we finally 
taste it will be all the greater, don't 
you think~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A cacao tree just for you, Trainer. And 
the precious fruit that grew upon it, 
exclusively for you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Those are precisely what I'd love for you 
to try~. I'm certain it will be an 
unforgettable flavor.
choice_data_list: You might have a point there...
You might be right about that...

text_block_list.text:
Nowadays, delicious chocolate is 
everywhere. However, the chocolate made 
from this cacao...

It must be an irreplaceable flavor. It 
seemed Mejiro Bright wanted to present 
just such an experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I promise you. Once this tree 
bears fruit, I shall make chocolate from 
it myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Grind, grind, gri~nd away♪ Slowly grating 
it down... That's right~, until it turns 
to powder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Another year goes by~.
choice_data_list:
...No, I'd actually like you to hurry 
there.

...No, I'd really like you to hurry up 
there.

text_block_list.text:
"...At this rate, each step will take a 
whole year. Smiling wryly, the two enjoyed 
the view of the cacao field."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We won't just be making it in the first 
year, you know~? The cacao tree, in fact—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it bears fruit for fifty whole 
years~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. In the meantime, I'd like to make 
chocolates every single year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the flavor must change with every 
year~. Depending on the weather and 
temperature. And also...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We change year by year as well, you know~ 
Accumulating countless memories along the 
way.

After fifty years, many things will 
change. Everything we have now might be 
completely different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Changing is a little scary, but it is 
also exciting~. Change, too, is a treasure 
to us. And..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I believe there are some things that 
never change, too~ And that is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The House of Mejiro, and the bond between 
the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe this. That our bond will 
last for eternity...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even fifty years from now, I'm sure... 
we'll still be talking together. At the 
base of this great, grown tree.

Right now, it is still a small tree. 
However, from now on, this tree shall—

We must nurture it. So that it becomes an 
eternal tree, just like the Mejiro family.
